meta.title: Add configurable CPU count option for containerized environments
meta.body_summary: Add --cpus CLI/config option to coturn to manually override CPU detection in containers, preventing resource exhaustion from host CPU overcount.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added --cpus CLI option with validation; cursor bot flagged bugs in edge-case handling; maintainer committed refactor and approved after manual test; merged after ~77h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 113 changed lines, this is a small-change by absolute volume. It fits a targeted configuration addition performance PR that merged successfully after review feedback and manual testing.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] reported two bugs: (1) invalid --cpus <1 logs error but does not exit or set cpus_configured, causing silent fallback; (2) --cpus value is overridden by DEFAULT_CPUS_NUMBER minimum bound even when user-configured. ggarber requested lint fix via @copilot.
review_details.performance_claim: Override CPU detection to prevent excessive relay threads and DB connections in containerized environments where host CPU count is high.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: C option parsing and integration with existing CPU detection logic required careful handling of validation edge cases; cursor bot flagged subtle bugs around error handling and configuration override.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] and copilot bot performed static analysis to identify edge-case bugs.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI lint check failed initially, and Copilot fixed it in a follow-up commit.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes test commands and expected output for verifying thread count, but no performance benchmark or profiling data.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: ggarber committed a refactor (898725) simplifying CPU configuration logic, possibly addressing bot-reported bugs; Copilot committed a fix for clang-format lint error.

core_change_summary.description: Added --cpus CLI/config option in mainrelay.c/h to override system CPU count for relay thread number, with input validation (1–128), documentation in man page and example config.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation and example config updates to explain the new option.
change_trajectory: Copilot added CPU option parsing and integration in mainrelay.c/h with configuration file section.
Added man page documentation and code formatting.
ggarber refactored CPU configuration logic for clarity and consistency, removing unnecessary braces.
Copilot fixed lint formatting issue after maintainer request.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot posted PR overview; reviewed all files and suppressed a test-coverage comment, and two inline comments: one suggesting exit on invalid input, another nitpick on unnecessary braces.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer later refactored braces; exit suggestion not explicitly applied.

review_signals.summary: Invalid --cpus <1 should set cpus_configured or exit; otherwise silent fallback occurs.
Nitpick: unnecessary scope block adds nesting; should be removed.
review_signals.action_taken: ggarber removed the extra braces in subsequent refactor commit.

review_signals.summary: Cursor bot flagged two bugs: (1) invalid --cpus leads to silent fallback, (2) --cpus override incorrectly applied minimum bound. Provided fix options.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer committed refactor that may have addressed these; merged without explicit resolution comment.

review_signals.summary: ggarber requested @copilot to fix the lint formatting issue.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot committed a fix for clang-format violations.
